questions.q: Which actor plays Clint Barton, the original Hawkeye, in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.why: Jeremy Renner has played Clint Barton since Thor (2011).

questions.q: What weapon is Clint Barton best known for?
questions.why: Hawkeye has no superpowers and relies on archery and trick arrows.

questions.q: After leaving an orphanage, Clint and his brother joined which kind of show?
questions.why: The brothers ran off to the Carson Carnival of Traveling Wonders.

questions.q: Which 2011 MCU film included Hawkeye's screen debut?
questions.why: Hawkeye debuted in a cameo in Thor (2011).

questions.q: Which young hero did Clint bless to keep using the Hawkeye codename?
questions.why: Clint gave Kate Bishop his blessing to keep the Hawkeye name.

questions.q: Clint married fellow hero Bobbi Morse. What is her codename?
questions.why: Bobbi Morse, Mockingbird, became Clint's wife.

questions.q: What was the name of Clint's brother, who ran away with him?
questions.why: Barney was killed fighting Egghead's allies, and later revealed to have been an FBI agent.

questions.q: In Avengers #63 (1969), Clint took on a new identity after his bow broke. Which?
questions.why: In Avengers #63 (1969), he became Goliath after his bow broke.

questions.q: Which alias did Clint adopt in New Avengers #27 (April 2007)?
questions.why: He used the Ronin alias starting New Avengers #27 (April 2007).

questions.q: Which writer-artist team launched volume 4 of Hawkeye in August 2012?
options: Brian Michael Bendis and Alex Maleev
questions.why: Matt Fraction and David Aja launched Hawkeye volume 4 in August 2012.
